info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Operation Mutual Fund Administration-spec
info.description: The Market Operation Management API facilitates the administration of mutual fund operations, enabling users to efficiently manage market transactions. Through this endpoint, users can execute actions related to mutual fund administration, such as initiating fund setups and updating market operation details. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions, investment firms, and fund managers looking to streamline their mutual fund operations. Developers can integrate this functionality into their applications to enhance financial service offerings.

post.summary: Create a new mutual fund administration record.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new record for mutual fund administration. It requires specific details and parameters that define the attributes of the mutual fund. Upon successful creation, the record will be stored and can be managed subsequently through other endpoints.
